tasks.label: Tizen: Build & Install on TV
tasks.command: set -euo pipefail; PROJECT="${workspaceFolder}"; [ -f "$PROJECT/.env" ] || { echo 'ERROR: .env not found'; exit 1; }; set -a; source "$PROJECT/.env"; set +a; [ -n "$TIZEN" ] && [ -n "$SDB" ] && [ -n "$TV" ] && [ -n "$PROFILE" ] && [ -n "$BUILD_DIR" ] || { echo 'ERROR: .env must set TIZEN, SDB, TV, PROFILE, BUILD_DIR'; exit 1; }; BUILD="$PROJECT/$BUILD_DIR"; echo '=== Connect ==='; "$SDB" connect "$TV" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; case "$("$SDB" devices)" in *"$TV"*) ;; *) echo "ERROR: TV $TV is not connected"; exit 1;; esac; echo '=== Clean ==='; rm -rf "$BUILD"; echo '=== Build ==='; "$TIZEN" build-web -e .git -e '.git/*' -e .env -e .env.example -e '.vscode/*' -e 'Debug/*' -e README.md -e '*.wgt' -- "$PROJECT"; echo '=== Package & sign ==='; "$TIZEN" package -t wgt -s "$PROFILE" -- "$BUILD"; WGT="$(find "$BUILD" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name '*.wgt' -print -quit)"; [ -n "$WGT" ] || { echo 'ERROR: WGT not found'; exit 1; }; case "$(unzip -l "$WGT")" in *signature1.xml*) ;; *) echo "ERROR: $WGT is not signed - check PROFILE=$PROFILE"; exit 1;; esac; echo "WGT: $WGT"; echo '=== Install ==='; "$TIZEN" install -s "$TV" -n "$(basename "$WGT")" -- "$(dirname "$WGT")"; echo '=== DONE ==='
